title: Canary District Segway Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Glide through a local Toronto neighbourhood on your brand-new Canary District Segway Tour — a thrilling and scenic ride through a historic and rapidly evolving part of Toronto.

This 1-hour Segway tour is the only one of its kind in Toronto, offering a faster cruise speed, outdoor fun, and compelling stories from Toronto’s easternmost downtown neighbourhood. Whether you’re a returning rider or a first-timer, you’ll enjoy this Segway experience that combines history, lush park scenes, architecture, art, and pure riding joy into one epic bucket-list adventure.

Cruise along picturesque bike trails and vibrant streets into the heart of the Canary District and the West Don Lands. Hear how this once-industrial pocket of the city transformed into a model for urban renewal — all while riding your very own Segway PT.
